newsitem.title: FRANCE: ITT sells part of Alcatel stake.
newsitem.headline: ITT sells part of Alcatel stake.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom said in a statement that ITT Corporation had sold three million of its shares to a large U.S. investment fund, after having made request to the company to be allowed to do so.
"Alcatel Alsthom has agreed to this request and appreciates the satisfactory conditions in which its capital ownership is evolving," it said in a statement.
Following the deal ITT holds 4.5 million shares, or 2.8 percent, in Alcatel.
In April 1996, ITT sold 2.1 million shares to another large U.S. investment fund.

ITT obtained a stake of 9.1 million shares in 1992 after Alcatel's acquisition of ITT's 30 percent stake in Alcatel NV, which followed on an earlier deal in which Alcatel acquired ITT's European telecommunication equipment activities.
Under the 1992 deal, ITT agreed to retain its shares up until July 3,1997.
"The 1992 agreement will continue to be applied to the Alcatel Alsthom shares which ITT Corporation continues to hold," Alcatel said.
Alcatel shares closed at 573 francs, down 2.05 percent, in a market in which the blue-chip index gained 1.12 percent.
Alcatel gave no financial details of the transaction but at Thursday's closing price the transation was worth 1.72 billion francs.
An Alcatel spokesman said that the question whether ITT chairman Rand Araskog would remain on the Alcatel supervisory board was "not on the agenda".
ITT is currently fighting a hostile $6.5 billion bid by Hilton Hotels Corp.
